chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Abu Bakr, he said:

I said to him, 'I lead a group in prayer.' He said, 'You give one salutation (taslim) and do not turn your head, saying: Peace be upon you, O Prophet, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Peace be upon you.' And do not recite anything from 'Alif-Lam-Mim' (Al-Ha-Mim) in the Fajr prayer.

key_terms.آلِ حَم: Alif-Lam-Mim (referring to Surah Ash-Shura or similar Meccan surahs starting with these letters)
key_terms.تُسَلِّمُ: You give the final salutation (taslim) ending the prayer

ai.seo_question: What are the specific instructions for an Imam leading prayer regarding salutation and Quranic recitation?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* outlines specific procedural nuances for the Imam during congregational prayer, emphasizing the single salutation (taslim) and the exclusion of Surah Al-Ha-Mim in Fajr. It reflects the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on precise ritual conduct and the distinct practices of the Imam compared to the congregation, rooted in the teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt.
